name: query_explain
description: Explain a computed answer for the Query view in four parts - plan, result, answer, evidence - each a high-level summary first with details folded and formatted (tables, queries, records, numbers); each part is its own capability (explain_plan, explain_result, explain_answer, explain_evidence). Load when the user finds an answer hard to read or asks how an answer was explained.
